Here are the descriptions of the provided plots, following your guidelines:

The plot illustrates the relationship between epoch and Word Error Rate (WER) for different fine-tuning types. The x-axis is labeled "epoch" and has a linear scale, ranging from 0 to 6 with tick labels at integer values. The y-axis is labeled "WER" and has a linear scale, ranging from 20 to 70 with tick labels at intervals of 10. 

A dashed gray line, marked with circle symbols, begins at approximately 62 at epoch 0 and decreases to approximately 41 at epoch 6. A dashed orange line, marked with square symbols, starts at approximately 58 at epoch 0 and decreases to approximately 38 at epoch 6. A dotted light blue line, marked with diamond symbols, begins at approximately 31 at epoch 0 and remains relatively stable at approximately 30 at epoch 6. A dashed pink line, marked with star symbols, starts at approximately 28 at epoch 0 and increases to approximately 33 at epoch 6.
